narrative.overview:
The workspace is a graphite cutting mat on a print-shop bench. The sheet lies on the mat at true scale, with a millimetre grid behind it that starts at the sheet's own corner and rulers along its top and left edges carrying mm numerals. To the left the deck reads as a tournament decklist: count first, ruled rows, a double-ruled total. To the right the settings read as a job ticket: plain labels on the left, values in tabular mono on the right. The one live colour is cerulean blue, the colour of a cut line, and it marks only what is selected, focused, the next action, or something the app changed that the user has not yet accepted.

Density is that of a working tool, not a dashboard. Everything lies flat on the mat. Sections are separated by hairline rules, not boxed. The white sheet is the brightest object on screen and nothing competes with it. Overlays (dialogs, popovers, menus, the toast) are the only things that leave the surface.

The system replaces an earlier glassy dark-SaaS look and refuses its devices: glass bars, glows, boxes nested inside boxes, eyebrow labels and side-stripe callouts.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite neutrals in four close steps, paper white for the sheet only, cerulean blue as the single live colour.
The mat grid and rulers are drawn at the sheet's own scale, so 10 mm on the mat is 10 mm on paper.
System sans for words in three sizes (12 / 14 / 18); system mono with tabular figures for every number.
Selection is drawn as crop-mark corners, the same marks the printer gets.
Flat, ruled sections; only overlays lift.
Drawn line icons at a 1.5 stroke, never glyphs.

rules.name: The One Live Colour Rule
rules.body: Cerulean Blue is the only hue that means "act on this" or "this is the current one". If something is blue, it is selected, focused, the next action, a cut line, or a change awaiting acceptance. Nothing else is blue.

rules.name: The Changed-Until-Accepted Rule
rules.body: When the app changes a setting on the user's behalf, the value stays blue in the job ticket, with a note and explicit choices, until the user accepts it. The output never changes silently.

rules.name: The Paper Is Brightest Rule
rules.body: Sheet Paper is reserved for the sheet. No UI surface is lighter than Chalk Text, and no surface uses the paper colour.

rules.name: The Mono Numbers Rule
rules.body: A number is set in mono with tabular figures wherever it appears, including inside sentences of status text. Words never are.

rules.name: The Three Sizes Rule
rules.body: UI text uses 12, 14 and 18px. Hierarchy beyond that comes from weight and placement, not new sizes.

rules.name: The Flat On The Mat Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the workspace casts a shadow or sits in a box inside another box. A section is a rule above a heading, not a card. If it does not float over the workspace, it does not lift.

dos: **Do** keep Cerulean Blue (#3daee9) for selection, focus, the primary action, cut lines and changed-until-accepted values only.
**Do** set every number in system mono with tabular figures.
**Do** separate sections with a 1px Hairline Rule (#3c3e43) and lay them flat on the mat.
**Do** keep control borders at Field Edge (#6c6f76) or stronger so every control edge is at least 3:1.
**Do** draw the mat grid and rulers at the sheet's own scale, aligned to the sheet's corner.
**Do** use drawn SVG icons at a 1.5 stroke.
donts: **Don't** add a second accent hue, a lavender accent, gradients or glows.
**Don't** use glass or blurred bars, or shadows on anything that does not float over the workspace.
**Don't** nest a bordered panel inside another bordered panel.
**Don't** add eyebrow labels or uppercase tracked kickers above headings.
**Don't** use a thick coloured stripe on one side of a callout.
**Don't** introduce UI text sizes outside 12, 14 and 18px.
**Don't** make any UI surface as bright as the sheet.
**Don't** use the bundled serif faces (Crimson Text, Goudy Bookletter 1911, Spectral) for UI text; they exist only to render custom cards.
